Bacterial_dermatosis.verification_note: Close-ups of dog skin with pustules/crusts/epidermal collarettes, red erosive patches - consistent with pyoderma. 27 colour-tinted non-diagnostic fur frames quarantined. Visually overlaps with fungal class.

Fungal_infections.verification_note: Erythematous, hyperpigmented, lichenified/greasy skin (malassezia-like) and alopecic patches - plausible. 40 tinted artifact frames quarantined. Not separable from bacterial by eye at thumbnail scale.

Healthy.verification_note: After removing 46 tinted artifact frames, remainder is mostly whole-dog breed/stock photos, not skin close-ups. Labels are correct (no visible lesions) but domain differs from disease classes -> shortcut risk.

Hypersensitivity_allergic_dermatosis.verification_note: Ventral erythema, papules, paw/periocular/ear-pinna inflammation, an intradermal allergy test plate - consistent with atopy/allergy. 9 tinted artifact frames quarantined.

Flea_Allergy.verification_note: Cat skin close-ups with miliary crusts/papules, flea dirt visible - consistent. Heavily augmented: many rotated copies of the same few photos (smeared edge fill), so true unique count is far below 250; one annotation/blank frame seen.

Health.verification_note: Generic whole-cat photos (incl. a few drawings/cartoons). No lesions - label correct, but domain differs from close-up disease classes -> shortcut risk.

Ringworm.verification_note: Circular alopecic, scaly/crusted lesions on face, ears, paws, body - matches ringworm well. Best class of the set.

Scabies.verification_note: Severe crusting of face/ears/body in stray cats - consistent with notoedric mange. Many are social-video screenshots with Indonesian captions, and many flipped/mirrored duplicates.
